entities.summary: Anthony Stolarz is an American professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Toronto Maple Leafs of the National Hockey League (NHL). Nicknamed Stolie, Stolarz previously played for the Philadelphia Flyers, Edmonton Oilers, Anaheim Ducks and Florida Panthers. He won the Stanley Cup in 2024 with the Panthers.
